en-US.One shared ring for everyone, today only: One shared ring for everyone, today only.

en-US.Each mode states its goal: reach a lengt: Each mode states its goal: reach a length, beat a score, survive the clock or outlast your rivals.
en-US.In Practice, press {undo} (or Ctrl+Z) to: In Practice, press {undo} (or Ctrl+Z) to rewind a bad moment. Undo is not available in ranked modes.
en-US.Grow to 9 m. No rivals, no thorns — just: Grow to 9 m. No rivals, no thorns — just you and the motes.
en-US.Boost is yours now. Reach 13 m — boostin: Boost is yours now. Reach 13 m — boosting spends length, so spend it well.
en-US.Reed drifts the ring. Outgrow it: reach: Reed drifts the ring. Outgrow it: reach 15 m first.
en-US.Two rivals graze the garden. Reach 16 m: Two rivals graze the garden. Reach 16 m before they do.
en-US.A wide ring, sparse motes. Survive 90 se: A wide ring, sparse motes. Survive 90 seconds.
en-US.Three thorn clusters wake in the ring. R: Three thorn clusters wake in the ring. Reach 15 m without pricking yourself.
en-US.Four rivals, thorns, and a score to beat: Four rivals, thorns, and a score to beat: 2600 points.
en-US.Ember light, three hungry rivals. Reach: Ember light, three hungry rivals. Reach 17 m.
en-US.Cut across a rival's line and live: elim: Cut across a rival's line and live: eliminate 1 serpent.
Six clusters of ember thorn. Reach 18 m.
en-US.A narrow ring. Survive 2 minutes with fo: A narrow ring. Survive 2 minutes with four rivals.
en-US.Bloom motes burn bright. Score 2400; boo: Bloom motes burn bright. Score 2400; boost often, eat what you shed.
en-US.Last one glowing wins. Outlive all five: Last one glowing wins. Outlive all five rivals.
A slender ring of frost. Reach 18 m.
en-US.Sparse motes in a wide field. Survive 15: Sparse motes in a wide field. Survive 150 seconds.
A small ring, six rivals. Reach 22 m.
en-US.Motes everywhere, rivals too. Reach 22 m: Motes everywhere, rivals too. Reach 22 m.
en-US.Ten thorn clusters guard the pollen. Rea: Ten thorn clusters guard the pollen. Reach 23 m.
en-US.Score 5200. The ring rewards the patient: Score 5200. The ring rewards the patient.
en-US.Score 2600 in 2 minutes, six rivals raci: Score 2600 in 2 minutes, six rivals racing you.
Outlive seven rivals in a thorned ring.
The orchard glows violet. Reach 24 m.
en-US.Eight rivals, ten thorn clusters, one wi: Eight rivals, ten thorn clusters, one winner.
en-US.Score 8000 in the heart of the void. Bec: Score 8000 in the heart of the void. Become the ring.
en-US.Your serpent always glides forward. You: Your serpent always glides forward. You choose where.

en-US.Follow the ring all the way around once: Follow the ring all the way around once without touching the edges.
en-US.Well steered. Glide on a moment to finis: Well steered. Glide on a moment to finish.
Motes of light are food. Food is length.
en-US.Eat 5 motes. Aim your path through the g: Eat 5 motes. Aim your path through the glowing seeds.
en-US.Grow to 10 m. Watch your ribbon lengthen: Grow to 10 m. Watch your ribbon lengthen behind you.
en-US.Spend length for speed. What you shed, y: Spend length for speed. What you shed, you may eat again.
en-US.Hold boost (pointer press, Space, or gam: Hold boost (pointer press, Space, or gamepad A) and glide fast for a breath.
en-US.Turn around and eat 3 of the motes you s: Turn around and eat 3 of the motes you shed.
Bodies are walls. Heads are fragile.
en-US.Glide near a rival's trail — then bend a: Glide near a rival's trail — then bend away. Never touch another body.
en-US.Make a rival strike your body: cut acros: Make a rival strike your body: cut across its path — or simply outlast the moment.
en-US.Everything together: steer, gather, boos: Everything together: steer, gather, boost, avoid, outlast.
en-US.Reach 13 m and survive among rivals and: Reach 13 m and survive among rivals and thorns.
en-US.Reach 13 m in 45 seconds. Speed target —: Reach 13 m in 45 seconds. Speed target — waste nothing.
en-US.A boost budget of 240 ticks for the whol: A boost budget of 240 ticks for the whole run. Reach 15 m.
en-US.Sixteen thorn clusters, an altered narro: Sixteen thorn clusters, an altered narrow layout. Reach 15 m.
en-US.No boost at all. Pure lines. Reach 16 m: No boost at all. Pure lines. Reach 16 m among four rivals.
en-US.Score 2000 points in 75 seconds. Nothing: Score 2000 points in 75 seconds. Nothing but appetite.
en-US.Six fierce rivals. One life. Outlast the: Six fierce rivals. One life. Outlast them all.
en-US.Two gentle rivals, a wide ring, no thorn: Two gentle rivals, a wide ring, no thorns.
en-US.Four rivals, a few thorns — the classic: Four rivals, a few thorns — the classic ring.
Seven sharp rivals in a thorned ring.
en-US.One shared ring for everyone today. Rank: One shared ring for everyone today. Rank by score when time runs out.

Erwischt – achte auf Rand, Insel und Dornen.
de-DE.Steer, gather light, and outlast the rin: Lenke, sammle Licht und überdauere den Ring.
de-DE.Grow to 9 m. No rivals, no thorns — just: Wachse auf 9 m. Keine Rivalen, keine Dornen – nur du und die Funken.
Sammle Funken, um 12 m zu erreichen.

de-DE.Two rivals graze the garden. Reach 16 m: Zwei Rivalen grasen im Garten. Erreiche 16 m vor ihnen.

de-DE.Three thorn clusters wake in the ring. R: Drei Dornenbüschel erwachen im Ring. Erreiche 15 m, ohne dich zu stechen.
de-DE.Four rivals, thorns, and a score to beat: Vier Rivalen, Dornen und eine Punktzahl zum Schlagen: 2600 Punkte.
de-DE.Ember light, three hungry rivals. Reach: Glutlicht, drei hungrige Rivalen. Erreiche 17 m.
de-DE.Cut across a rival's line and live: elim: Kreuze die Linie eines Rivalen und überlebe: Schalte 1 Schlange aus.
de-DE.A narrow ring. Survive 2 minutes with fo: Ein schmaler Ring. Überlebe 2 Minuten mit vier Rivalen.
de-DE.Bloom motes burn bright. Score 2400; boo: Blütenfunken leuchten hell. Hole 2400 Punkte; boost oft und friss, was du abwirfst.
de-DE.Last one glowing wins. Outlive all five: Wer zuletzt glüht, gewinnt. Überdauere alle fünf Rivalen.
de-DE.Score 2200 among patient, watchful rival: Hole 2200 Punkte unter geduldigen, wachsamen Rivalen.
de-DE.Sparse motes in a wide field. Survive 15: Wenige Funken auf weitem Feld. Überlebe 150 Sekunden.
Hole 1800 Punkte in 90 Sekunden. Bleib in Bewegung.
Fünf Rivalen singen dünn. Schalte 2 aus.
Ein kleiner Ring, sechs Rivalen. Erreiche 22 m.
de-DE.Motes everywhere, rivals too. Reach 22 m: Funken überall, Rivalen auch. Erreiche 22 m.
de-DE.Ten thorn clusters guard the pollen. Rea: Zehn Dornenbüschel bewachen den Pollen. Erreiche 23 m.
Schalte 3 Rivalen zwischen den Dornen aus.
de-DE.Score 5200. The ring rewards the patient: Hole 5200 Punkte. Der Ring belohnt Geduld.
de-DE.Score 2600 in 2 minutes, six rivals raci: Hole 2600 Punkte in 2 Minuten, während sechs Rivalen mit dir wetteifern.
Überdauere sieben Rivalen in einem Dornenring.
Der Obstgarten leuchtet violett. Erreiche 24 m.
de-DE.Eight rivals, ten thorn clusters, one wi: Acht Rivalen, zehn Dornenbüschel, ein Sieger.
de-DE.Score 8000 in the heart of the void. Bec: Hole 8000 Punkte im Herzen der Leere. Werde zum Ring.
de-DE.Your serpent always glides forward. You: Deine Schlange gleitet immer vorwärts. Du bestimmst, wohin.
de-DE.Steer: move your pointer (or hold ← / →): Lenken: Bewege den Zeiger (oder halte ← / →), um deinen Weg zu biegen. Dreh mindestens einen Viertelkreis.
de-DE.Follow the ring all the way around once: Folge dem Ring einmal ganz herum, ohne die Ränder zu berühren.
de-DE.Well steered. Glide on a moment to finis: Gut gelenkt. Gleite noch einen Moment weiter, um abzuschließen.
Lichtfunken sind Futter. Futter ist Länge.
de-DE.Eat 5 motes. Aim your path through the g: Friss 5 Funken. Lenke deinen Weg durch die leuchtenden Samen.
de-DE.Grow to 10 m. Watch your ribbon lengthen: Wachse auf 10 m. Sieh zu, wie dein Band hinter dir länger wird.
de-DE.Spend length for speed. What you shed, y: Tausche Länge gegen Tempo. Was du abwirfst, kannst du wieder fressen.
de-DE.Hold boost (pointer press, Space, or gam: Halte den Boost (Zeiger gedrückt, Leertaste oder Gamepad A) und gleite einen Atemzug lang schnell.
de-DE.Turn around and eat 3 of the motes you s: Dreh um und friss 3 der Funken, die du abgeworfen hast.
Körper sind Wände. Köpfe sind zerbrechlich.
de-DE.Glide near a rival's trail — then bend a: Gleite nah an der Spur eines Rivalen – dann bieg ab. Berühre nie einen anderen Körper.
de-DE.Make a rival strike your body: cut acros: Lass einen Rivalen gegen deinen Körper prallen: Kreuze seinen Weg – oder überstehe einfach den Moment.
de-DE.Everything together: steer, gather, boos: Alles zusammen: lenken, sammeln, boosten, ausweichen, überdauern.
de-DE.Reach 13 m and survive among rivals and: Erreiche 13 m und überlebe zwischen Rivalen und Dornen.
de-DE.Reach 13 m in 45 seconds. Speed target —: Erreiche 13 m in 45 Sekunden. Tempoziel – verschwende nichts.
de-DE.A boost budget of 240 ticks for the whol: Ein Boost-Budget von 240 Takten für den ganzen Lauf. Erreiche 15 m.
de-DE.Sixteen thorn clusters, an altered narro: Sechzehn Dornenbüschel, ein veränderter, enger Aufbau. Erreiche 15 m.
de-DE.No boost at all. Pure lines. Reach 16 m: Gar kein Boost. Reine Linien. Erreiche 16 m unter vier Rivalen.
de-DE.Score 2000 points in 75 seconds. Nothing: Hole 2000 Punkte in 75 Sekunden. Nichts als Appetit.
de-DE.Six fierce rivals. One life. Outlast the: Sechs wilde Rivalen. Ein Leben. Überdauere sie alle.
de-DE.Two gentle rivals, a wide ring, no thorn: Zwei sanfte Rivalen, ein weiter Ring, keine Dornen.
de-DE.Four rivals, a few thorns — the classic: Vier Rivalen, ein paar Dornen – der klassische Ring.
Sieben scharfe Rivalen in einem Dornenring.
de-DE.One shared ring for everyone today. Rank: Heute ein gemeinsamer Ring für alle. Rangfolge nach Punkten, wenn die Zeit abläuft.

fr-FR.Free play against bot rivals. Pick a dif: Jeu libre contre des rivaux robots. Choisissez une difficulté.
fr-FR.Five interactive lessons, one mechanic a: Cinq leçons interactives, une mécanique à la fois.
fr-FR.One shared ring for everyone, today only: Un anneau commun pour tous, aujourd’hui seulement.
Votre serpent glisse tout seul vers l’avant. Dirigez-le avec le pointeur ou avec {left} et {right} ; maintenez {boost} pour accélérer. {pause} met en pause.
fr-FR.Gather light motes to grow and score. Th: Ramassez des grains de lumière pour grandir et marquer des points. Le bord pâle, l’île sombre et les épines rouges mettent fin à votre course, sauf si les règles en disposent autrement.
fr-FR.Each mode states its goal: reach a lengt: Chaque mode annonce son objectif : atteindre une longueur, battre un score, tenir le chrono ou survivre à vos rivaux.
fr-FR.In Practice, press {undo} (or Ctrl+Z) to: En Entraînement, appuyez sur {undo} (ou Ctrl+Z) pour revenir sur un mauvais moment. L’annulation n’existe pas dans les modes classés.
fr-FR.Down — press Play again to retry the les: Perdu : appuyez sur Rejouer pour refaire la leçon.
Perdu : attention au bord, à l’île et aux épines.
fr-FR.Ended: every step of {name} complete: Fin : toutes les étapes de {name} réussies
fr-FR.Steer, gather light, and outlast the rin: Dirigez, récoltez la lumière et survivez à l’anneau.
fr-FR.Serpent Ring playfield: Terrain de jeu de Serpent Ring
fr-FR.Grow to 9 m. No rivals, no thorns — just: Grandissez jusqu’à 9 m. Ni rivaux ni épines : juste vous et les grains.
Ramassez des grains pour atteindre 12 m.
fr-FR.Boost is yours now. Reach 13 m — boostin: L’accélération est à vous. Atteignez 13 m : accélérer coûte de la longueur, dépensez-la bien.
fr-FR.Reed drifts the ring. Outgrow it: reach: Reed dérive dans l’anneau. Dépassez-le : atteignez 15 m en premier.
fr-FR.Two rivals graze the garden. Reach 16 m: Deux rivaux broutent le jardin. Atteignez 16 m avant eux.
fr-FR.A wide ring, sparse motes. Survive 90 se: Un anneau large, peu de grains. Survivez 90 secondes.
fr-FR.Three thorn clusters wake in the ring. R: Trois touffes d’épines s’éveillent dans l’anneau. Atteignez 15 m sans vous piquer.
fr-FR.Four rivals, thorns, and a score to beat: Quatre rivaux, des épines et un score à battre : 2600 points.
fr-FR.Ember light, three hungry rivals. Reach: Lueur de braise, trois rivaux affamés. Atteignez 17 m.
fr-FR.Cut across a rival's line and live: elim: Coupez la trajectoire d’un rival et survivez : éliminez 1 serpent.
Six touffes d’épines de braise. Atteignez 18 m.
fr-FR.A narrow ring. Survive 2 minutes with fo: Un anneau étroit. Survivez 2 minutes avec quatre rivaux.
fr-FR.Bloom motes burn bright. Score 2400; boo: Les grains de fleur brillent fort. Marquez 2400 ; accélérez souvent et mangez ce que vous lâchez.
fr-FR.Last one glowing wins. Outlive all five: Le dernier qui brille gagne. Survivez aux cinq rivaux.
Un fin anneau de givre. Atteignez 18 m.
fr-FR.Score 2200 among patient, watchful rival: Marquez 2200 parmi des rivaux patients et attentifs.
fr-FR.Sparse motes in a wide field. Survive 15: Peu de grains dans un vaste champ. Survivez 150 secondes.
Marquez 1800 en 90 secondes. Ne vous arrêtez pas.
Un petit anneau, six rivaux. Atteignez 22 m.
Marquez 4200 sous les lumières de givre.
fr-FR.Motes everywhere, rivals too. Reach 22 m: Des grains partout, des rivaux aussi. Atteignez 22 m.
fr-FR.Ten thorn clusters guard the pollen. Rea: Dix touffes d’épines gardent le pollen. Atteignez 23 m.
fr-FR.Score 2600 in 2 minutes, six rivals raci: Marquez 2600 en 2 minutes, face à six rivaux pressés.
Survivez à sept rivaux dans un anneau épineux.
Le verger luit de violet. Atteignez 24 m.
fr-FR.Eight rivals, ten thorn clusters, one wi: Huit rivaux, dix touffes d’épines, un seul vainqueur.
fr-FR.Score 8000 in the heart of the void. Bec: Marquez 8000 au cœur du vide. Devenez l’anneau.
fr-FR.Your serpent always glides forward. You: Votre serpent avance toujours. Vous choisissez où.
fr-FR.Steer: move your pointer (or hold ← / →): Dirigez : déplacez le pointeur (ou maintenez ← / →) pour courber votre trajet. Tournez d’au moins un quart de tour.
fr-FR.Follow the ring all the way around once: Faites le tour complet de l’anneau sans toucher les bords.
fr-FR.Well steered. Glide on a moment to finis: Bien dirigé. Glissez encore un instant pour terminer.
Les grains de lumière sont de la nourriture. La nourriture, c’est de la longueur.
fr-FR.Eat 5 motes. Aim your path through the g: Mangez 5 grains. Passez par les graines lumineuses.
fr-FR.Grow to 10 m. Watch your ribbon lengthen: Grandissez jusqu’à 10 m. Regardez votre ruban s’allonger derrière vous.
Attrapez un grain de fleur brillant.
fr-FR.Spend length for speed. What you shed, y: Dépensez de la longueur pour la vitesse. Ce que vous lâchez, vous pouvez le remanger.
D’abord, prenez des forces : mangez 6 grains.
fr-FR.Hold boost (pointer press, Space, or gam: Maintenez l’accélération (pointeur enfoncé, Espace ou A sur la manette) et filez un instant.
fr-FR.Turn around and eat 3 of the motes you s: Faites demi-tour et mangez 3 des grains que vous avez lâchés.
Les corps sont des murs. Les têtes sont fragiles.
fr-FR.Glide near a rival's trail — then bend a: Glissez près de la traînée d’un rival, puis écartez-vous. Ne touchez jamais un autre corps.
fr-FR.Make a rival strike your body: cut acros: Faites heurter votre corps à un rival : coupez-lui la route, ou tenez simplement le coup.
fr-FR.Everything together: steer, gather, boos: Tout ensemble : diriger, ramasser, accélérer, éviter, survivre.
fr-FR.Reach 13 m and survive among rivals and: Atteignez 13 m et survivez parmi les rivaux et les épines.
fr-FR.Reach 13 m in 45 seconds. Speed target —: Atteignez 13 m en 45 secondes. Objectif vitesse : ne gaspillez rien.
fr-FR.A boost budget of 240 ticks for the whol: Un budget d’accélération de 240 tics pour toute la partie. Atteignez 15 m.
fr-FR.Sixteen thorn clusters, an altered narro: Seize touffes d’épines, un tracé étroit modifié. Atteignez 15 m.
fr-FR.No boost at all. Pure lines. Reach 16 m: Aucune accélération. Des lignes pures. Atteignez 16 m parmi quatre rivaux.
fr-FR.Score 2000 points in 75 seconds. Nothing: Marquez 2000 points en 75 secondes. Rien que de l’appétit.
fr-FR.Six fierce rivals. One life. Outlast the: Six rivaux féroces. Une seule vie. Survivez à tous.
fr-FR.Two gentle rivals, a wide ring, no thorn: Deux rivaux paisibles, un anneau large, aucune épine.
fr-FR.Four rivals, a few thorns — the classic: Quatre rivaux, quelques épines : l’anneau classique.
Sept rivaux redoutables dans un anneau épineux.
fr-FR.One shared ring for everyone today. Rank: Un anneau commun pour tous aujourd’hui. Classement au score à la fin du temps.

pt-BR.Free play against bot rivals. Pick a dif: Jogo livre contra rivais bots. Escolha uma dificuldade.
pt-BR.Five interactive lessons, one mechanic a: Cinco lições interativas, uma mecânica por vez.
pt-BR.One shared ring for everyone, today only: Um anel compartilhado para todos, só hoje.
pt-BR.Constrained goals: clocks, limits, thorn: Metas com restrições: relógios, limites, espinhos.
Sua serpente desliza para a frente sozinha. Conduza com o ponteiro ou com {left} e {right}; segure {boost} para acelerar. {pause} pausa.
pt-BR.Gather light motes to grow and score. Th: Colete partículas de luz para crescer e pontuar. A borda clara, a ilha escura e os espinhos vermelhos encerram seu percurso, a não ser que as regras digam o contrário.
pt-BR.Each mode states its goal: reach a lengt: Cada modo diz sua meta: atingir um comprimento, superar uma pontuação, aguentar o relógio ou sobreviver aos rivais.
pt-BR.In Practice, press {undo} (or Ctrl+Z) to: No Treino, pressione {undo} (ou Ctrl+Z) para voltar um momento ruim. Desfazer não está disponível nos modos ranqueados.
pt-BR.Down — press Play again to retry the les: Você caiu: toque em Jogar de novo para repetir a lição.
Você caiu: cuidado com a borda, a ilha e os espinhos.
pt-BR.Ended: every step of {name} complete: Fim: todos os passos de {name} concluídos
pt-BR.Steer, gather light, and outlast the rin: Conduza, colete luz e sobreviva ao anel.
pt-BR.Serpent Ring playfield: Campo de jogo do Serpent Ring
pt-BR.Grow to 9 m. No rivals, no thorns — just: Cresça até 9 m. Sem rivais nem espinhos: só você e as partículas.
Colete partículas para chegar a 12 m.
pt-BR.Boost is yours now. Reach 13 m — boostin: Agora você pode acelerar. Chegue a 13 m: acelerar gasta comprimento, então gaste bem.
pt-BR.Reed drifts the ring. Outgrow it: reach: Reed vaga pelo anel. Supere-o: chegue a 15 m primeiro.
pt-BR.Two rivals graze the garden. Reach 16 m: Dois rivais pastam no jardim. Chegue a 16 m antes deles.
pt-BR.A wide ring, sparse motes. Survive 90 se: Um anel largo, poucas partículas. Sobreviva 90 segundos.
pt-BR.Three thorn clusters wake in the ring. R: Três tufos de espinhos despertam no anel. Chegue a 15 m sem se espetar.
pt-BR.Four rivals, thorns, and a score to beat: Quatro rivais, espinhos e uma pontuação a bater: 2600 pontos.
pt-BR.Ember light, three hungry rivals. Reach: Luz de brasa, três rivais famintos. Chegue a 17 m.
pt-BR.Cut across a rival's line and live: elim: Corte a linha de um rival e sobreviva: elimine 1 serpente.
Seis tufos de espinhos de brasa. Chegue a 18 m.
pt-BR.A narrow ring. Survive 2 minutes with fo: Um anel estreito. Sobreviva 2 minutos com quatro rivais.
pt-BR.Bloom motes burn bright. Score 2400; boo: As partículas de flor brilham forte. Faça 2400; acelere sempre e coma o que soltar.
pt-BR.Last one glowing wins. Outlive all five: Vence o último a brilhar. Sobreviva aos cinco rivais.
Um anel fino de geada. Chegue a 18 m.
pt-BR.Score 2200 among patient, watchful rival: Faça 2200 entre rivais pacientes e atentos.
Oito tufos de espinhos. Chegue a 20 m.
pt-BR.Sparse motes in a wide field. Survive 15: Poucas partículas num campo amplo. Sobreviva 150 segundos.
Um anel pequeno, seis rivais. Chegue a 22 m.
Faça 4200 sob as luzes de geada.
pt-BR.Motes everywhere, rivals too. Reach 22 m: Partículas por toda parte, rivais também. Chegue a 22 m.
pt-BR.Ten thorn clusters guard the pollen. Rea: Dez tufos de espinhos guardam o pólen. Chegue a 23 m.
pt-BR.Score 5200. The ring rewards the patient: Faça 5200. O anel recompensa a paciência.
pt-BR.Score 2600 in 2 minutes, six rivals raci: Faça 2600 em 2 minutos com seis rivais na disputa.
Sobreviva a sete rivais num anel com espinhos.
O pomar brilha em violeta. Chegue a 24 m.
pt-BR.Eight rivals, ten thorn clusters, one wi: Oito rivais, dez tufos de espinhos, um vencedor.
pt-BR.Score 8000 in the heart of the void. Bec: Faça 8000 no coração do vazio. Torne-se o anel.
pt-BR.Your serpent always glides forward. You: Sua serpente sempre desliza para a frente. Você escolhe para onde.
pt-BR.Steer: move your pointer (or hold ← / →): Conduza: mova o ponteiro (ou segure ← / →) para curvar o caminho. Gire pelo menos um quarto de volta.
pt-BR.Follow the ring all the way around once: Dê uma volta completa no anel sem tocar nas bordas.
pt-BR.Well steered. Glide on a moment to finis: Boa condução. Deslize mais um pouco para terminar.
Partículas de luz são comida. Comida é comprimento.
pt-BR.Eat 5 motes. Aim your path through the g: Coma 5 partículas. Passe pelas sementes brilhantes.
pt-BR.Grow to 10 m. Watch your ribbon lengthen: Cresça até 10 m. Veja sua fita se alongar atrás de você.
Pegue uma partícula de flor brilhante.
pt-BR.Spend length for speed. What you shed, y: Troque comprimento por velocidade. O que você solta pode comer de novo.
pt-BR.Hold boost (pointer press, Space, or gam: Segure a aceleração (ponteiro pressionado, Espaço ou A no controle) e deslize rápido por um instante.
pt-BR.Turn around and eat 3 of the motes you s: Dê a volta e coma 3 das partículas que você soltou.
Corpos são paredes. Cabeças são frágeis.
pt-BR.Glide near a rival's trail — then bend a: Deslize perto do rastro de um rival e depois se afaste. Nunca toque outro corpo.
pt-BR.Make a rival strike your body: cut acros: Faça um rival bater no seu corpo: corte o caminho dele ou apenas aguente o momento.
pt-BR.Everything together: steer, gather, boos: Tudo junto: conduzir, coletar, acelerar, desviar, sobreviver.
pt-BR.Reach 13 m and survive among rivals and: Chegue a 13 m e sobreviva entre rivais e espinhos.
pt-BR.Reach 13 m in 45 seconds. Speed target —: Chegue a 13 m em 45 segundos. Meta de velocidade: não desperdice nada.
pt-BR.A boost budget of 240 ticks for the whol: Um limite de aceleração de 240 tiques para a partida inteira. Chegue a 15 m.
pt-BR.Sixteen thorn clusters, an altered narro: Dezesseis tufos de espinhos num traçado estreito e alterado. Chegue a 15 m.
pt-BR.No boost at all. Pure lines. Reach 16 m: Sem aceleração. Linhas puras. Chegue a 16 m entre quatro rivais.
pt-BR.Score 2000 points in 75 seconds. Nothing: Faça 2000 pontos em 75 segundos. Só apetite.
pt-BR.Six fierce rivals. One life. Outlast the: Seis rivais ferozes. Uma vida. Sobreviva a todos.
pt-BR.Two gentle rivals, a wide ring, no thorn: Dois rivais tranquilos, um anel largo, sem espinhos.
pt-BR.Four rivals, a few thorns — the classic: Quatro rivais, alguns espinhos: o anel clássico.
Sete rivais afiados num anel com espinhos.
pt-BR.One shared ring for everyone today. Rank: Um anel compartilhado para todos hoje. Classificação por pontos quando o tempo acabar.

it-IT.Five interactive lessons, one mechanic a: Cinque lezioni interattive, una meccanica alla volta.
it-IT.One shared ring for everyone, today only: Un anello condiviso per tutti, solo oggi.
Il tuo serpente scivola in avanti da solo. Guidalo con il puntatore o con {left} e {right}; tieni premuto {boost} per lo scatto. {pause} mette in pausa.
it-IT.Gather light motes to grow and score. Th: Raccogli granelli di luce per crescere e fare punti. Il bordo chiaro, l’isola scura e le spine rosse fermano la tua corsa, a meno che le regole non dicano altrimenti.
it-IT.Each mode states its goal: reach a lengt: Ogni modalità indica il suo obiettivo: raggiungere una lunghezza, battere un punteggio, resistere al cronometro o sopravvivere ai rivali.
it-IT.In Practice, press {undo} (or Ctrl+Z) to: In Allenamento premi {undo} (o Ctrl+Z) per tornare indietro da un brutto momento. L’annullamento non è disponibile nelle modalità classificate.
it-IT.Down — press Play again to retry the les: Fuori: premi Gioca ancora per ripetere la lezione.
Fuori: attento al bordo, all’isola e alle spine.
it-IT.Ended: every step of {name} complete: Fine: tutti i passi di {name} completati
it-IT.Steer, gather light, and outlast the rin: Guida, raccogli la luce e resisti all’anello.
it-IT.Serpent Ring playfield: Campo di gioco di Serpent Ring
it-IT.Grow to 9 m. No rivals, no thorns — just: Cresci fino a 9 m. Niente rivali né spine: solo tu e i granelli.
Raccogli granelli per arrivare a 12 m.
it-IT.Boost is yours now. Reach 13 m — boostin: Ora hai lo scatto. Arriva a 13 m: lo scatto consuma lunghezza, quindi usala bene.
it-IT.Reed drifts the ring. Outgrow it: reach: Reed vaga per l’anello. Superalo: arriva per primo a 15 m.
it-IT.Two rivals graze the garden. Reach 16 m: Due rivali pascolano nel giardino. Arriva a 16 m prima di loro.
it-IT.A wide ring, sparse motes. Survive 90 se: Un anello ampio, pochi granelli. Sopravvivi 90 secondi.
it-IT.Three thorn clusters wake in the ring. R: Tre ciuffi di spine si risvegliano nell’anello. Arriva a 15 m senza pungerti.
it-IT.Four rivals, thorns, and a score to beat: Quattro rivali, spine e un punteggio da battere: 2600 punti.
it-IT.Ember light, three hungry rivals. Reach: Luce di brace, tre rivali affamati. Arriva a 17 m.
it-IT.Cut across a rival's line and live: elim: Taglia la traiettoria di un rivale e sopravvivi: elimina 1 serpente.
Sei ciuffi di spine di brace. Arriva a 18 m.
it-IT.A narrow ring. Survive 2 minutes with fo: Un anello stretto. Sopravvivi 2 minuti con quattro rivali.
it-IT.Bloom motes burn bright. Score 2400; boo: I granelli di fiore brillano forte. Fai 2400; scatta spesso e mangia ciò che perdi.
it-IT.Last one glowing wins. Outlive all five: Vince l’ultimo che brilla. Sopravvivi a tutti e cinque i rivali.
Un sottile anello di brina. Arriva a 18 m.
it-IT.Score 2200 among patient, watchful rival: Fai 2200 tra rivali pazienti e attenti.
Otto ciuffi di spine. Arriva a 20 m.
it-IT.Sparse motes in a wide field. Survive 15: Pochi granelli in un campo vasto. Sopravvivi 150 secondi.
Un anello piccolo, sei rivali. Arriva a 22 m.
Fai 4200 sotto le luci di brina.
it-IT.Motes everywhere, rivals too. Reach 22 m: Granelli ovunque, rivali pure. Arriva a 22 m.
it-IT.Ten thorn clusters guard the pollen. Rea: Dieci ciuffi di spine proteggono il polline. Arriva a 23 m.
it-IT.Score 2600 in 2 minutes, six rivals raci: Fai 2600 in 2 minuti, con sei rivali in gara.
Sopravvivi a sette rivali in un anello di spine.
Il frutteto brilla di viola. Arriva a 24 m.
it-IT.Eight rivals, ten thorn clusters, one wi: Otto rivali, dieci ciuffi di spine, un vincitore.
it-IT.Score 8000 in the heart of the void. Bec: Fai 8000 nel cuore del vuoto. Diventa l’anello.
it-IT.Your serpent always glides forward. You: Il tuo serpente avanza sempre. Scegli tu dove.
it-IT.Steer: move your pointer (or hold ← / →): Guida: muovi il puntatore (o tieni premuto ← / →) per curvare il percorso. Gira almeno di un quarto di giro.
it-IT.Follow the ring all the way around once: Percorri tutto l’anello una volta senza toccare i bordi.
it-IT.Well steered. Glide on a moment to finis: Ben guidato. Scivola ancora un attimo per finire.
I granelli di luce sono cibo. Il cibo è lunghezza.
it-IT.Eat 5 motes. Aim your path through the g: Mangia 5 granelli. Passa tra i semi luminosi.
it-IT.Grow to 10 m. Watch your ribbon lengthen: Cresci fino a 10 m. Guarda il tuo nastro allungarsi.
Prendi un granello di fiore luminoso.
it-IT.Spend length for speed. What you shed, y: Spendi lunghezza per la velocità. Ciò che perdi puoi rimangiarlo.
it-IT.Hold boost (pointer press, Space, or gam: Tieni premuto lo scatto (puntatore premuto, Spazio o A sul controller) e scivola veloce per un attimo.
it-IT.Turn around and eat 3 of the motes you s: Torna indietro e mangia 3 dei granelli che hai perso.
I corpi sono muri. Le teste sono fragili.
it-IT.Glide near a rival's trail — then bend a: Scivola vicino alla scia di un rivale, poi allontanati. Non toccare mai un altro corpo.
it-IT.Make a rival strike your body: cut acros: Fai sbattere un rivale contro il tuo corpo: tagliagli la strada, oppure resisti e basta.
it-IT.Everything together: steer, gather, boos: Tutto insieme: guidare, raccogliere, scattare, schivare, resistere.
it-IT.Reach 13 m and survive among rivals and: Arriva a 13 m e sopravvivi tra rivali e spine.
it-IT.Reach 13 m in 45 seconds. Speed target —: Arriva a 13 m in 45 secondi. Obiettivo velocità: non sprecare nulla.
it-IT.A boost budget of 240 ticks for the whol: Un budget di scatto di 240 tick per tutta la partita. Arriva a 15 m.
it-IT.Sixteen thorn clusters, an altered narro: Sedici ciuffi di spine in un percorso stretto e modificato. Arriva a 15 m.
it-IT.No boost at all. Pure lines. Reach 16 m: Nessuno scatto. Linee pure. Arriva a 16 m tra quattro rivali.
it-IT.Score 2000 points in 75 seconds. Nothing: Fai 2000 punti in 75 secondi. Solo appetito.
it-IT.Six fierce rivals. One life. Outlast the: Sei rivali feroci. Una vita. Sopravvivi a tutti.
it-IT.Two gentle rivals, a wide ring, no thorn: Due rivali tranquilli, un anello ampio, nessuna spina.
it-IT.Four rivals, a few thorns — the classic: Quattro rivali, qualche spina: l’anello classico.
Sette rivali agguerriti in un anello di spine.
it-IT.One shared ring for everyone today. Rank: Un anello condiviso per tutti oggi. Classifica per punti allo scadere del tempo.
